results.question: workspace 단위로 vault와 retriever를 어떻게 묶나요?

hits.title: KnowledgeFactory binds knowledge to workspace and region
Semantic note retrieval searches pgvector note embeddings
Agent runtime wires workspace retriever into execution and knowledge-only route
Canonical concept retrieval uses promoted active concepts only

grounding: [bsvibe-src-002] KnowledgeFactory is the central per-workspace/per-region constructor. It roots every vault at region/workspace_id, exposes workspace-scoped Vault and GardenWriter objects, and constructs the workspace-scoped retriever used by runtime components. This makes workspace scoping a first-class RAG metadata requirement.

[bsvibe-src-011] SemanticNoteRetriever embeds incoming signals and searches a NoteVectorBackend, while PgNoteVectorBackend stores/searches note_embeddings by workspace_id and embedding_model using pgvector cosine distance. Semantic search is auxiliary, capped, similarity-filtered, and workspace-scoped.

[bsvibe-src-007] The agent runtime builds a workspace-scoped KnowledgeFactory retriever, optionally composes SemanticNoteRetriever when embeddings are configured, injects retriever into executor/native loops, and routes knowledge_only frames to KnowledgeAnswerOrchestrator. This proves RAG context is consumed at runtime, not only stored.

[bsvibe-src-003] CanonConceptRetriever extracts candidate tags from work signals, resolves them through the canonicalization index, and returns active concept display statements. It is bounded, workspace-scoped, graceful-empty, and never raises into verification, so promoted concepts should be separated from raw notes in the dataset.

[bsvibe-src-025] settle_runtime exposes two factories the SettleWorker depends on: build_settle_entity_extractor_factory creates a per-settlement IngestCompiler routed through the same GatewayDispatcher the chat path uses with the workspace's single active non-executor account, and build_note_embed_hook embeds the absorbed note summary with the deployment embedder and upserts the vector into pgvector note_embeddings keyed by vault pa th.

workspace 단위로 vault와 retriever를 묶는 방법은 KnowledgeFactory가 제공하는 기능입니다. 

KnowledgeFactory는 workspace-scoped Vault와 GardenWriter objects, 그리고 workspace-scoped retriever를 expose합니다. 이 retriever는 runtime components에 의해 사용되며, workspace scoping이 RAG metadata의 first-class requirement입니다.

KnowledgeFactory는 vault를 region/workspace_id로 루트하고, workspace-scoped retriever를 제공합니다. 이 retriever는 SemanticNoteRetriever와 PgNoteVectorBackend를 포함하여 다양한 구성 요소를 포함할 수 있습니다.

workspace-scoped retriever는 CanonConceptRetriever와 settle_runtime의 SettleWorker에 의해 사용됩니다. CanonConceptRetriever는 candidate tags를 추출하고 canonicalization index를 통해 resolve합니다. settle_runtime은 IngestCompiler와 GatewayDispatcher를 통해 note embeddings을 upsert합니다.

因此, workspace 단위로 vault와 retriever를 묶는 방법은 KnowledgeFactory를 사용하여 workspace-scoped retriever를 expose하고, runtime components가 이 retriever를 사용하는 것을 garant하는 것입니다.

This is strong evidence that decision memory is runtime-critical data.

[bsvibe-src-023] The EventBus module defines EventType enums for plugin and skill lifecycle, vault writes (SEED_WRITTEN, GARDEN_WRITTEN, ACTION_LOGGED), vault mutations (NOTE_UPDATED, NOTE_DELETED), scheduler triggers, agent tool calls, and ingest compile batch events. The RAG dataset should therefore track note_type/source_type so retrieval can rank canonical concepts before decisions and negative patterns.

[bsvibe-src-016] RetractionService persists a RetractionSignal to ontology_corrections, opens a 30s DB-backed undo window, and lets apply_pending sweep tombstone the note via GardenWriter once the deadline passes. Issue and undo are idempotent on signal id, and the per-workspace _garden_lock prevents interleaving with concurrent canon merges or settle writes.
results.answer:
canon_watcher가 실시간 감시를 하고, canon-lint는 사후 검출을 합니다. 

canon_watcher는 external edits를 감지하고 NOTE_UPDATED 또는 NOTE_DELETED 이벤트를.emit합니다. CanonicalizationIndexSubscriber는 affected paths를.invalidate합니다.

canon-lint는 canonicalization index와 note store를 scan하여 read-only findings를 emit합니다. Findings는 severity(error vs warning)가 있지만 vault를 mutate하지 않습니다. CanonConceptRetriever와 CompositeCanonRetriever는 canonical concepts를 extract하고, canon-lint plugin은 markdown report로 rendering합니다.

canon_watcher는 self-host only이고 runtime_config.canon_watcher_enabled에 gated됩니다. SaaS deployments에서는 canon_watcher가 disabled입니다. 

canon-lint는 real-time 감시를 하지 않습니다. 사후 검출을 하기 때문에, external edits가 발생할 때까지 canonicalization index와 note store의 state가 유지되었습니다.

results.question: event note 와 fact note 의 frontmatter 차이는 무엇인가요?

hits.title: Semantic note retrieval searches pgvector note embeddings
Fact note frontmatter — typed triple with supersedes chain
Event note frontmatter — attendees and belongs_to wikilink lists
Person note frontmatter — related list with ambiguity marker
EventBus enumerates lifecycle, vault, and ingest events for streaming

grounding: [bsvibe-src-011] SemanticNoteRetriever embeds incoming signals and searches a NoteVectorBackend, while PgNoteVectorBackend stores/searches note_embeddings by workspace_id and embedding_model using pgvector cosine distance. Semantic search is auxiliary, capped, similarity-filtered, and workspace-scoped.

[bsvibe-vault-001] Real fact note shape from extractor test fixture: frontmatter declares type=fact, subject/predicate/object as wikilinks, valid_from/valid_to, source_type=explicit, and supersedes a prior fact id. Body is the human-readable summary. Example: type: fact, title: 'Blasin의 현재 역할', subject: [[Blasin]], predicate: has_role, object: [[AX Team Lead]], valid_from: 2024-06, supersedes: [[fact-blasin-backend-dev]].

[bsvibe-vault-002] Real event note shape: type=event, title, attendees list of wikilinks, belongs_to list of wikilinks, optional knowledge_layer=episodic. Body holds free-form meeting notes. Example: type: event, title: 'Team Standup', attendees: [[Alice]], [[Bob]], belongs_to: [[Project X]]. RAG chunking must preserve list semantics so retrieval can answer 'who attended X' from the frontmatter, not just the body.

[bsvibe-vault-003] Real person note shape: type=person, title, related list of wikilinks where a trailing ? marks the link as AMBIGUOUS. Example: type: person, title: Bob, related: [[Alice]], [[Charlie]]?. The extractor turns related into related_to edges; ambiguous markers should propagate as a confidence field on the chunk metadata so retrieval can downweight uncertain links.

[bsvibe-src-023] The EventBus module defines EventType enums for plugin and skill lifecycle, vault writes (SEED_WRITTEN, GARDEN_WRITTEN, ACTION_LOGGED), vault mutations (NOTE_UPDATED, NOTE_DELETED), scheduler triggers, agent tool calls, and ingest compile batch events. Everything that needs to be surfaced as a real-time stream goes through one typed enum so the bus stays uniform across subsystems.

event note와 fact note의 frontmatter는 다음과 같은 차이가 있습니다.

- event note: 
  - type=event
  - title
  - attendees list of wikilinks
  - belongs_to list of wikilinks
  - optional knowledge_layer=episodic
  - body holds free-form meeting notes

- fact note:
  - type=fact
  - subject/predicate/object as wikilinks
  - valid_from/valid_to
  - source_type=explicit
  - supersedes a prior fact id
  - body is the human-readable summary
